# vantage_custom_calculation (Resource)

Manages a Custom Calculation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vantage_custom_calculation" "tokens" {
  title       = "Token usage"
  description = "Token usage across both unit spellings."
  operation   = "sum"

  filter = {
    type       = "sum"
    filter     = "costs.provider = 'openai'"
    usage_unit = ["Tokens", "tokens"]
  }
}

resource "vantage_cost_report" "ai" {
  title                     = "AI usage"
  workspace_token           = var.workspace_token
  date_interval             = "last_month"
  custom_calculation_tokens = [vantage_custom_calculation.tokens.token]
}

variable "workspace_token" {
  type = string
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `filter` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))
- `title` (String) The title of the Custom Calculation.

### Optional

- `cost_report_tokens` (Set of String) The attached Cost Report tokens. Omit to leave attachments unmanaged or set an empty set to clear them. Manage a given attachment from only one resource.
- `description` (String) An optional description. Remove it from the configuration to clear it.
- `display_as` (String) The display format of the calculation. Defaults to ratio when creating a calculation.
- `operation` (String) The operation applied to the filtered cost or usage data. Defaults to sum when creating a calculation.
- `unit_scale` (Number) The integer unit scale of the calculation. Defaults to 1.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the CustomCalculation.
- `token` (String) The token of the CustomCalculation.

<a id="nestedatt--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Optional:

- `filter` (String) The VQL filter for a sum, average, min, or max calculation.
- `filter_denominator` (String) The VQL filter for the denominator of a division calculation.
- `filter_numerator` (String) The VQL filter for the numerator of a division calculation.
- `type` (String) The calculation operation. Use filter and usage_unit for aggregate operations, or the numerator and denominator fields for division.
- `usage_unit` (List of String) Non-empty list of equivalent usage unit names. Omit to use costs. Units are summed without conversion.
- `usage_unit_denominator` (List of String) Non-empty list of equivalent usage unit names. Omit to use costs. Units are summed without conversion.
- `usage_unit_numerator` (List of String) Non-empty list of equivalent usage unit names. Omit to use costs. Units are summed without conversion.
